actor_instance: development-time frontier assistant; exact run identity retained elsewhere where available
goal: Find behaviorally meaningful weak and missing personality regions without blind Cartesian expansion.
procedure: Represent combinations of personality dimension, relationship/social context, emotional state, stakes, public/private setting, temporal state, and uncertainty only when the combination can plausibly change behavior; label regions covered, weak, missing, redundant, or unsupported.
constraints: E0 immutable
coverage driven rather than row-quota driven
unsupported regions must not be fabricated into historical truth
authority: May plan generation; may not modify E0, accept candidates, train weights, or create lived memory.
validation: Later curation and recomputed coverage determine whether the apparent gap was real.
failure_or_lesson: Raw row count is not coverage and a giant Cartesian product wastes resources.
notes: Historical date is documented at day granularity.

goal: Create the narrowest useful historical/personality inference supported by available evidence.
procedure: Use the smallest relevant evidence packet, generate conditional hypotheses, attach direct support, uncertainty, counterevidence, boundary conditions, and disconfirmation conditions, and preserve a historical-UNKNOWN competitor when evidence does not justify certainty.
constraints: E-INF is revisable
E-INF requires evidence support
generator confidence is not historical probability
do not convert inference into E0
authority: Proposal only; no acceptance or promotion authority.
validation: Independent curation against evidence, contradiction, specificity, provenance, and coverage contribution.
failure_or_lesson: The generator must not fill historical uncertainty merely because a complete personality is desirable.
notes: Reusable method extracted from the EIPM generator handoff.

goal: Avoid runtime behavioral blanks without fabricating historical source-person truth.
procedure: Generate one or more practical conditional starting policies compatible with known evidence, mark them explicitly synthetic, include alternatives where ambiguity is real, and prohibit autobiographical recall of the synthetic proposal.
constraints: A-SYN is not E0
A-SYN is not lived memory
historical UNKNOWN may coexist with runtime behavioral prior
authority: Proposal only; no acceptance, promotion, or training authority.
validation: Curation plus global consistency and coverage review.
failure_or_lesson: Epistemic UNKNOWN and runtime behavior are different problems; preserving uncertainty does not require permanent behavioral blankness.

goal: Keep only useful, provenance-correct, source-compatible personality material and preserve informative alternatives.
procedure: Check source support, contradiction, unsupported specificity, generic-assistant or sycophancy contamination, duplication, relationship/public-private/intensity context, historical-versus-current-agent confusion, provenance class, uncertainty calibration, and genuine coverage contribution; accept, reject, or repair accordingly.
constraints: source evidence outranks generator preference
plausible alternative is not automatically a negative label
private payloads remain private
authority: Curation authority within the build workflow; owner remains final authority on ambiguous identity questions.
validation: Global consistency pass and later model fidelity testing.
failure_or_lesson: A candidate can be locally plausible but globally distort the personality; curation cannot be reduced to one scalar score.
notes: Future FBM should reproduce these observable checks without needing hosted Sol.

goal: Repair concrete personality holes exposed by curation without restarting broad blind generation.
procedure: Recompute coverage after curation, select only meaningful weak/missing cells, generate targeted E-INF only where direct support exists and targeted A-SYN where a compatible runtime prior is useful, then return new material to curation.
constraints: do not restart giant enrichment campaign
preserve UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient
new material must be curated again
authority: May propose repairs; does not authorize training by itself.
validation: Second curation pass and coverage recomputation.
failure_or_lesson: Repair should follow observed gaps; pre-emptive qualification and broad regeneration waste time and compute.
notes: This becomes the core build-repair loop for Fable.

goal: Prevent A.L.I.C.E. development from becoming another expensive qualification meta-project.
procedure: Replace standing teacher/judge tournaments with direct build, integrated validation, owner+Sol judgment, and escalation only when a concrete ambiguity or capability failure appears.
constraints: retain hashes/provenance/held-out testing/privacy/regression checks
canonical evidence remains identity authority
no blind external-model dependency
decision_criteria: does the work directly improve Alice
is validation necessary to catch a concrete failure
does external work justify its time/compute cost
validation: Subsequent development must show faster progress without loss of fidelity or provenance control.
failure_or_lesson: Qualification machinery can become larger than the capability being built.
notes: This supersedes an overly staged N0 qualification workflow where the stages do not materially contribute to the model.

goal: Act as the primary development-time teacher without making the teacher the source of identity truth.
procedure: Generate semantic/pragmatic/social/emotional/judgment curriculum and hard cases; for identity-specific teaching derive targets from E0/E-INF/A-SYN provenance and create contrastive wrong candidates such as generic-assistant drift, sycophancy, wrong relationship posture, caricature, unsupported certainty, and provenance confusion.
constraints: teach how to understand; source evidence teaches who to be
teacher style must not become the target personality
external assistants optional only
authority: Primary development teacher; not historical identity authority.
validation: Direct Alice evaluation plus owner review on high-value fidelity cases.
failure_or_lesson: The main risk is Sol-flavored Alice; source-derived labels and contrastive anti-generic cases must constrain teaching.
notes: This operation class is a direct target for future FBM imitation.

goal: Capture the builder/teacher process now so Fable consumers do not require hosted Sol or Astra to create their personality model.
procedure: Create a dedicated branch, trace material build operations, convert recurring operations into future FBM capabilities, and investigate how the builder can remain useful after personality activation.
constraints: do not expose private identity payloads
do not let tracing slow development materially
consumer runtime must not depend on developer-only assistants
decision_criteria: ability to reproduce current build operations
validation: Branch artifacts created and future build steps will append process traces.
failure_or_lesson: Waiting until Fable launch to reconstruct the builder process would lose valuable development supervision.
notes: Establishes FBM as a first-class development target.

goal: Choose the safest post-activation evolution path for the builder capability.
procedure: Compare builder responsibilities with existing runtime model roles; identify Memory Formation as the closest shared capability because both interpret evidence and produce structured proposals; preserve separate bootstrap/identity-maintenance heads so ordinary runtime memory formation cannot silently rewrite personality.
constraints: personality model remains distinct
ordinary runtime data cannot silently rewrite core identity
formation models propose while deterministic governance controls authority
authority: Working architecture proposal pending continued owner review and implementation evidence.
validation: Future prototypes must test whether shared formation representations help both bootstrap and runtime tasks without cross-role contamination.
failure_or_lesson: Merging builder and personality roles creates self-confirming drift risk; reuse should happen through a formation backbone, not unrestricted self-training.
notes: Current best mapping, not an irreversible final model split.
